# syrup_bottle

Current audit status: **FAIL — not certified to the requested physical and image thresholds.** Confirmed mechanical defects were repaired; the limitations below remain.


## Articulation audit (supersedes earlier PASS/grade claims)

Restored circular upright cap/bottle sections, refitted both instances, and made the 2 mm/turn screw mechanism consistent across native and interchange exports. Replaced the contradictory negative-angle rotation interval with 0 to 3 turns, coupled to 0 to 6 mm lift. Pitch and release threshold remain explicit priors.

- screw_cap_rotation: rest PASS; axis hardware FAIL (unmeasured); contact sweep PASS (max penetration 0.000001 mm); source-open reprojection FAIL.
- cap_thread_lift: rest PASS; axis hardware FAIL (unmeasured); contact sweep PASS (max penetration 0.000001 mm); source-open reprojection FAIL.

Strict 10 px instance edge test: maximum 21.540 px across 6 calibrated views. Residual failures are retained, not hidden by IoU averages. See ../artcheck_report.json and ../review/artcheck_syrup_bottle.jpg.

Contact geometry: per-part convex annuli, finite walls and separate moving pieces. Parent contacts enabled, no exclusions. Within-body overlapping manufacturing primitives are rigid unions. Closed rest is q=0; source-open q is stored separately in model.json. model.xml is the authoritative mechanism runtime; URDF uses mimic screw translation. Blender rigid constraints do not implement the screw coupling. GLB preserves part names and textures.

Support contact was constrained to the supplied scene layout (sink 1.025 m; preparation counter 0.955 m), eliminating the unconstrained silhouette fit's support penetration. Z scale was adjusted while holding the first closure height fixed. This is inherited layout geometry, not an independent metric survey.

Physical properties: material-volume mass and COM estimates were recalculated after geometry repair. Existing friction, damping, spring and 2 mm thread-pitch priors were retained; no force, mass or stop measurement was performed. Hidden threads and sealing gaskets remain simplified. No new capture or online estimation; camera calibration and 4% scale uncertainty are inherited.

Measured CPU timing: asset build 2.472 s; audit 0.673 s; calibrated rendering 63.476 s. Excludes manual inspection/fitting and failed/retried render processes.

Outstanding: strict reprojection and hidden-axis/physical-stop certification fail. A targeted close/open video with visible hinge hardware and metric reference is needed to establish the unavailable physical measurements. ARTCHECK_DONE is deliberately not asserted.

Historical notes are preserved in ../review/artcheck/before/syrup_bottle/notes.md.
